[ISTS.1.1] libds ships two test suites with different jobs:

| Suite | Includes | Author | Catches |
|---|---|---|---|
| **impl** | internal headers + `libds.h` | Whoever wrote the feature | Refactor regressions, internal-invariant breaks |
| **spec** | only `libds.h` + `spec_common.h` | Whoever wrote / cited the spec point | Spec drift, public-API gaps, behavior-not-implementation |
